read.thesis: Hilton is an asset-light hotel franchisor whose Q1 RevPAR rose 3.6% and full-year guidance was raised to 2–3%, but Middle East exposure is a stated risk; the capital-cycle read is supply-side positive (record 527,000-room pipeline, construction starts up 20%+).

triggers.label: Systemwide RevPAR guide raised to 2–3%
triggers.quote: for the full year, our System-wide RevPAR growth expectations are now 2% to 3%, factoring in a range of scenarios for the Middle East conflict and recovery
triggers.highlight: System-wide RevPAR growth expectations are now 2% to 3%

triggers.label: Construction starts to rise over 20%
